Name: Sequence limits
Basic relationship:
The sequence {1, \inf, a_n} is said to have the limit a if, for every given \e>0, there exists a number N_(\e) such that for all n>N_(\e), it holds that |a_n-a|<\e
Can be rewritten to lim{n->\inf, a_n}=a
Convergent: lim{n->\inf, a_n} = A
Divergent: lim{n->\inf, a_n} = \inf
